finding: _roles builds set(names) before checking element types, so an unhashable role such as [["pro"]] raises a bare TypeError instead of KnowledgeError.
why: The new guard promises KnowledgeError for malformed debater roles, but a list-of-lists input escapes it and the test matrix (strings, bytes, 5, [None], ["pro",""]) never covers it.
fix: Validate each element (isinstance str and non-empty) while iterating, before or instead of set(), or catch TypeError and raise KnowledgeError.
evidence:
roles = set(names)
    if not all(isinstance(name, str) and name for name in roles):
